approved_definition_context: The group is the full real orthogonal matrix group with the inherited matrix Borel structure. The displayed Haar constructor normalized on top:PositiveCompacts gives its actual canonical full-group Haar probability.

For ENNReal-valued measures, restrict is actual set restriction and scalar2 acts on measure values. IsProbabilityMeasure means that the actual measure of the whole carrier is1. Matrix determinant uses the standard finite real determinant.

The positive natural dimension is the only non-typing premise. Both half-masses and both probability properties are conclusions; no determinant witness, partition, invariance, integrability or Gaussian-family property is a caller assumption.
